title: Powers of investigation
question: What does Cpo Act 2000 section 26 say about powers of investigation?
shortAnswer: Cpo Act 2000 s.26 — ICPC may: enter/search premises, seize documents, summon witnesses, arrest, freeze accounts.
legalExplanation:
**Section 26 of the Cpo Act 2000** provides:

ICPC may: enter/search premises, seize documents, summon witnesses, arrest, freeze accounts

This provision empowers Cpo Act 2000 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
reviewNotes: Approved after review from Cpo Act 2000 s.26. Needs plain-language review and verification against official gazette.
